init.title: Reolink Talk options
init.description: Disabling certificate verification reduces connection security. Applies to device HTTP connections; live talk uses the official Reolink connection. Playback diagnostics apply only to files. Change one parameter at a time. Disabling command-response waits removes confirmation of packet acceptance. Initial buffering is a send-ahead budget, not a guaranteed device buffer.

data.diagnostic_wait_for_ack: Diagnostic: wait for command responses (default on)
data.diagnostic_logging: Diagnostic: bounded timing and PCM logging

error.invalid_diagnostics: Playback diagnostic values must be finite and within the displayed ranges.
